items.briefing:
Australia's communications regulator ACMA has taken Optus to Federal Court over a Triple Zero outage in September 2025, a reminder that critical service reliability has real legal consequences for providers. Separately, security awareness firm KnowBe4 has launched voice call (vishing) simulations to help organisations train staff against phone-based scams — a growing threat where attackers impersonate IT helpdesks or executives to trick employees into handing over credentials or access.

If your organisation hasn't tested staff against phone-based social engineering, now is a good time to ask your training provider about vishing awareness exercises.

featured.title: ACMA takes Optus to Federal Court over September 2025 Triple Zero outage
featured.quote: ACMA's Federal Court action against Optus for Triple Zero outage directly impacts Australian emergency services infrastructure.
